content.text:
I submitted **idx 0** (Fe 0.87, Sb 0.13), which had the highest EQE of the three I measured: **0.637%**.

**EQE measurements (all 3 used):**

| Index | Fe fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.87 | 0.637 |
| 1 | 0.86 | 0.577 |
| 8 | 0.70 | 0.099 |

EQE drops steadily as Sb increases.

**XRD (4 of 5 used, at idx 0, 4, 8 and 22):**
- **idx 0 to 8:** all look like the same rutile-type phase, close to FeSbO4. Only idx 0 has one extra weak peak, which may mean a little iron-rich material is present.
- **idx 22 (Sb-rich end):** still mainly that rutile phase, plus small peaks that look like antimony oxide. I saw no sign of a new phase that would absorb visible light better.

With only three EQE measurements, I measured nothing between idx 1 and idx 8, or anywhere past idx 8. Unless the library has a sharp peak somewhere I didn't measure, idx 0 at the iron-rich edge should be the best or very close to it.
